reason: Type error: def-routef-raw-factor-setting explicitly declares I_B to be the identity map of B, but this node applies v:B->A to I_B as if I_B were the unit element of B. Hence v(I_B), u(I-v(I_B)), and the claimed delta-homomorphism unit estimate ||I-v(I_B)|| are ill-typed. The argument must use a separately typed unit element of B (e.g. the unsubscripted I forced by v's domain), not the registered symbol I_B.
